## Open Source History

Punyapal is the author and maintainer of Pest's official plugins:

- pest-plugin-phpstan: https://github.com/pestphp/pest-plugin-phpstan
- pest-plugin-rector: https://github.com/pestphp/pest-plugin-rector

He is also the maintainer of laravel-extended-relationships, laravel-extended-commands, laravel-auth-jobs, and DocSmith, and has contributed to 100+ repositories across the Laravel and PHP ecosystem.
